_about: Spot checks re-opened on official sources on 2026-10-27 (Central). Only facts the source states are filled. Fort Worth was NOT re-confirmed (fortworthtexas.gov returned 403/404 to every fetch method), so it stays unverified.

san-antonio-tx-garage-sale-guide.fee: $20 per permit (non-refundable); 4th permit in a calendar year is free
san-antonio-tx-garage-sale-guide.sign_rules: Up to 3 signs, each 6 sq ft or smaller: 1 at the sale, 2 off premises with the city sign decals. Nothing on utility poles, street signs, traffic signs, or other right-of-way objects. Signs may go up 2 days before the sale and must come down when the permit expires.
san-antonio-tx-garage-sale-guide.how_to_apply: Online through the city's permit portal (no login needed), in person at the Development Services One Stop (1901 S. Alamo St.), or at participating H-E-B stores. Get it before the sale starts and post it in plain view.
san-antonio-tx-garage-sale-guide.notes: Limit is one sale per quarter, 4 per calendar year per residence. Selling 5 items or fewer needs no permit. Fee rose from $16.50 to $20 with the FY2027 fee schedule (Oct 1, 2026).

dallas-tx-garage-sale-guide.fee: $0 for the 1st permit, $25 for the 2nd permit in a 12-month period
dallas-tx-garage-sale-guide.sign_rules: 1 sign on the sale property, plus up to 5 signs at remote locations. Remote signs go on private property with the owner's permission. No signs in the right-of-way or medians. Remove all signs within 24 hours after the sale.
dallas-tx-garage-sale-guide.how_to_apply: Online only through Dallas Code Compliance. Have your driver's license or ID, a water bill, and a valid email.
dallas-tx-garage-sale-guide.notes: The 2-sale limit runs over any 12-month period, not the calendar year. Application details: https://dallascityhall.com/departments/codecompliance/Pages/garage-sales.aspx

long-beach-ca-garage-sale-guide.fee: $17 per permit (online applications add a $1.59 processing fee)
long-beach-ca-garage-sale-guide.sign_rules: 1 sign only, on the sale property, no taller than 4 ft and no larger than 6 sq ft. No directional or off-site signs.
long-beach-ca-garage-sale-guide.how_to_apply: Online (needs a Long Beach utility bill in your name or a past permit at the address), by email to LBBIZ@LongBeach.Gov, or in person at the Business License Division, 411 W. Ocean Blvd., 2nd Floor.
long-beach-ca-garage-sale-guide.notes: 2 per year applies to single-family homes; apartments get 1 per quarter. Processing fee source: https://www.longbeach.gov/finance/services-and-permits/convenience-fee/

tulsa-ok-garage-sale-guide.how_to_apply: No permit needed for up to 2 sales a year. More than 2 needs a special exception from the Board of Adjustment (Zoning Code Section 70.120).
tulsa-ok-garage-sale-guide.notes: Tulsa Zoning Code Section 50.050-A (as amended Oct 21, 2025). Limits are per lot, no matter who runs the sale. No merchandise bought for resale.
